provenance.runtimeCompatibility: Ordered primitive ids, features, labels, partitions, split audit, and metrics are identical after locale-neutral lowercasing; role coefficients and scores were not refit.
provenance.splitPolicy: Connected components over family, declared relations, lineage, seed identity, and five-token near duplicates at 0.72 for every partition. Positive-company identity creates edges only in labeled train/validation partitions; sealed test gold is not consulted. Negative surfaces never create component edges.
